name: kimi-plugin-cc
description: Universal Kimi Code connector for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, DeepSeek Harness, and Magpie: 4-tool MCP + SEP-2640 skills + canonical PreToolUse safety hook.

scripts.check: bun run build && bun run check:contracts && bun run check:surfaces && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test --bail && git diff --exit-code -- dist plugins/kimi-codex dsh/index.json cordis.patch.yml && UNTRACKED="$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- dist plugins/kimi-codex dsh/index.json cordis.patch.yml)" && { [ -z "$UNTRACKED" ] || { echo "drift gate: untracked generated files (stage them and re-run check):"; echo "$UNTRACKED"; exit 1; }; }
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun build runtime/hooks/approval-hook.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/hooks/approval-hook.js && mkdir -p dist/vendor/shell-quote dist/vendor/smol-toml && cp runtime/vendor/shell-quote/LICENSE dist/vendor/shell-quote/LICENSE && cp runtime/vendor/smol-toml/*.js runtime/vendor/smol-toml/LICENSE dist/vendor/smol-toml/ && echo '{"type":"module"}' > dist/package.json && chmod 755 dist/companion.js

author: Xule Lin
